headline: Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. files for insolvency
body: Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. has filed for insolvency proceedings; a provisional administrator keeps production running for now. Customers are advised to secure their supply.

headline: Credit insurer withdraws cover for Oberflächentechnik Weißacher GmbH
body: A trade credit insurer has withdrawn its limits for Oberflächentechnik Weißacher GmbH; suppliers of the coating shop now ask for prepayment.

headline: Konvertek Antriebselektronik GmbH: semiconductor supply back to normal
body: Konvertek Antriebselektronik GmbH reports that power semiconductor deliveries have normalised and that converter lead times will return to about twelve weeks over the winter.

headline: Pump makers report stable order intake
body: German pump makers report order intake in the third quarter roughly at last year's level, with building services weak and industry and water stronger.

headline: Strelvo group acquires Verbindungstechnik Mairhofer GmbH
body: The Mairhofer family has sold Verbindungstechnik Mairhofer GmbH to Strelvo, a group of fastener distributors. The company keeps its name and its sales team; prices will be set centrally by the group, as for all its member companies.

headline: Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH opens a new logistics centre
body: Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH has opened an automated logistics centre that will shorten delivery times for standard parts.
